services.excerpt: Full computer diagnosis for passenger and commercial vehicles. No guesswork.
services.intro: Every job starts with the computer, not the guess. Factory-grade diagnostics read what the vehicle is actually doing — then a technician confirms it on the ramp before anything is quoted.
includes: Full-system computer diagnostics for passenger and commercial vehicles
Engine, transmission and driveline mechanical work
Fault tracing that ends in a written finding, not a shrug

faq.q: Do you work on brands other than Isuzu?
faq.a: Yes. Isuzu is our authorised marque, but the bays serve multi-brand passenger and commercial vehicles every day.

faq.q: Will I get an estimate before work starts?
faq.a: Always. Diagnostics first, then a clear written estimate — by call or WhatsApp — before any work begins.

faq.q: How long does a diagnostic take?
faq.a: Most readings and inspections are same-day; the service desk gives you a realistic window when you book.

services.excerpt: Original equipment for Isuzu and multi-brand fleets.
services.intro: The right part, not the nearest part. Genuine and OEM-spec components for Isuzu and multi-brand fleets, ordered against your VIN so what fits on paper fits on the vehicle.
includes: Genuine Isuzu parts and OEM-equivalent components
VIN-based ordering to remove fitment guesswork
Fleet parts planning for scheduled maintenance
Parts staged against your booking so the bay never waits

faq.q: Can you source parts for older models?
faq.a: In most cases, yes. The desk confirms availability against your VIN before you commit to anything.

faq.q: Do you fit parts I bring in?
faq.a: We prefer to supply and warrant what we fit. For client-supplied parts we will quote labour separately and flag any fitment risk in writing first.

services.excerpt: Priority scheduling and reporting for the teams that report to you.
services.intro: A fleet is a promise to someone else's schedule. You get a single point of contact, priority bays, and reporting that reads well in a Monday meeting.
includes: One point of contact for your transport or operations lead
Priority scheduling and agreed turnaround windows
Per-unit service history and condition reporting
Staff personal vehicles handled to the same standard

faq.q: How do we start a fleet account?
faq.a: Call the desk and ask for the fleet coordinator. You will agree contact points, scheduling and reporting format before the first unit is booked.

faq.q: Can personal and company vehicles share one account?
faq.a: Yes — one desk for both. Company units keep fleet reporting; personal vehicles are simply looked after on the side.

services.excerpt: When something fails on the highway, we respond.
services.intro: Breakdowns don't book appointments. Call the desk and we coordinate recovery to the workshop on Thika Road — the diagnosis is already waiting when the vehicle arrives.
includes: Roadside response coordination on the Thika Road corridor
Recovery to the workshop with diagnosis on arrival
Priority re-entry to a bay once recovered
Fleet incident logging for insurance and reporting
Clear communication from call-out to handover

faq.q: What number do I call in a breakdown?
faq.a: The service desk on +254 700 941 698. Give us your location and the vehicle, and we coordinate from there.

faq.q: Do you recover vehicles you didn't service?
faq.a: Yes. Recovery is coordinated for any vehicle, and the workshop then gives you the same diagnostics-first estimate as a regular booking.

services.excerpt: Hunter Engineering precision — measured in seconds, felt for months.
services.intro: Alignment is where tyre money is saved or burned. Precision measurement and correction that stops the pull, ends the uneven wear, and keeps the steering where you left it.
includes: Post-impact checks after potholes or kerb strikes

faq.q: How often should alignment be checked?
faq.a: At least once a year, and after any significant impact — potholes on the corridor count. Uneven tyre wear or a pull is a check-now symptom.
We quote them together when both are due; balancing alone is a quick job and can be done while you wait.

services.excerpt: From a parking-lot scrape to full panel work, finished properly.
services.intro: Panel work is visible work. From door dings to full resprays, the finish is colour-matched, blended and cleared so the repair disappears.
includes: Trim and seal restoration to factory lines

faq.q: Do you deal with insurance assessments?
faq.a: Yes. We support the assessment process and document the repair the way insurers expect.

faq.q: How long does panel work take?
faq.a: It depends on the damage and paint cure times. You get a written timeline with the estimate, and a call if anything changes.

services.excerpt: A clean cabin after a long drive or before a client visit.
services.intro: The cabin is where your clients sit. Deep wash, interior detailing and upholstery care that make a five-year-old vehicle present like a new one.
includes: Exterior hand wash and protected finish

faq.q: Can detailing remove stains and odours?
faq.a: Most stains and odours, yes. Stubborn cases are assessed first and we tell you honestly what is achievable before you pay for it.
A full interior detail is typically a half-day job; the desk confirms a collection time when you book.

services.excerpt: Installed and supported for commercial compliance.
services.intro: Compliance shouldn't ground the fleet. Speed governors and tracking devices installed, calibrated and supported — with the paperwork your operations file expects.
includes: Speed governor supply, installation and calibration

faq.q: Can you calibrate governors installed elsewhere?
faq.a: Yes, existing units can be tested and calibrated; if a unit is beyond calibration we say so and quote the replacement plainly.

faq.q: Do you schedule installations around fleet uptime?
faq.a: That is the point of the bay — installations are planned in batches around your operating hours, not against them.

services.excerpt: Comfort and reliability systems kept in order.
services.intro: The systems you only notice when they fail. Wiring, charging, starting and air conditioning diagnosed and repaired before they become a roadside story.
includes: Air conditioning service, regas and leak tracing
Climate system checks before long routes

faq.q: My A/C is weak — is it always a regas?
faq.a: No. Weak cooling can be gas, a leak, the compressor or a blend door. We trace the actual fault before recommending anything.

faq.q: Do you trace intermittent electrical faults?
faq.a: Yes — intermittent faults are diagnosed methodically with the meter and the wiring diagram, not by swapping parts until it stops.

processSteps.title: Book the desk
processSteps.text: Call, WhatsApp or the booking form. You get a slot and a named contact — not a queue.

processSteps.title: Diagnose & inspect
processSteps.text: Computer diagnostics first, then a physical inspection on the ramp. Findings before opinions.

processSteps.title: Written estimate
processSteps.text: A clear quote by call or WhatsApp. Nothing is touched until you approve it.

processSteps.title: Work & quality check
processSteps.text: The bay completes the work to factory standards, then checks it before handover.

processSteps.title: Handover & history
processSteps.text: You collect the vehicle with a record of what was done — useful for the next service, the resale, or the board.
